title: Schema for the skirmish mission cards data file (their maps are on their missions rows)

id.description: Id for entry: a UUID (see docs/data-model.md).

format.description: How many players, and how they play: two players, or four in teams or each on their own.

scenario.description: Which of its map's two missions this is, as printed on the card (null until entered).

back_id.description: Foreign key to this card's back in data/card-backs.json.

image.description: The file path for this skirmish mission's image.
